items.description: Flex Mail is a web application that provides address hygiene (CASS, NCOA, De-duplication) and postal sorting for bulk mailing through the USPS as a seamless embedded function. This application uses the TEC Mailing API.
Useful mashup that lets you see who has been donating money to which political party by zip code. Good combination of raw data, charts and maps. Data source is The Fundrace Project.
A Chinese wiki service based on Google Maps.
Simple JavaScript app to find bookmarks from del.icio.us.
Using the ESPN API, PHP, and Bootstrap, I made a simple responsive news site, giving readers the top news in various sports.

A mashup that imports missed connection data from craigslist and locates them on the google map. The time slider on the top of the map enables users to go back the past 10 days. A submission page with a drawing board is provided so users can submit their missed connection via the website with a drawing.
A mashup of Google Maps and Flickr's hosted videos.
A mashup of Google maps and Google Ajax search API. You can use this site to search for anything, anywhere, on a fullscreen map.
Search and listen to songs instantly.
A map of crime in Richmond, Virginia's Church Hill Neighborhood going back to 2001.
Get a Foursquare widget for your site.
Google maps and a shout site that has a Roaming geek, find the Geek and shout any message you want on any location on the map.
The New York Times mashup of the best travel destinations for 2007. Map markers link to full stories in the Times travel section.
Interactive map, heatmaps, a geo-location mobile version, data feeds, and detail pages of every Cleanup Site and Permitted Facility from the CA Department of Toxic Substances Control Datasets.
Shows geolocated online social activity around universities and colleges in California. Offers a statistics tool to monitor student population, including age, gender and ethnic origin of members.
